mapper.insert: insert into kg_contradictions ( id, entity_topic, relationship_a_id, relationship_b_id, source_a_book, source_b_book, description, status, agent_review_result, admin_notes, detected_at, reviewed_at, resolved_at ) values ( #{contradiction.id, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{contradiction.entityTopic}, #{contradiction.relationshipAId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{contradiction.relationshipBId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{contradiction.sourceABook}, #{contradiction.sourceBBook}, #{contradiction.description}, #{contradiction.status}, #{contradiction.agentReviewResult}, #{contradiction.adminNotes}, #{contradiction.detectedAt}, #{contradiction.reviewedAt}, #{contradiction.resolvedAt} )
mapper.select: select id, entity_topic, relationship_a_id, relationship_b_id, source_a_book, source_b_book, description, status, agent_review_result, admin_notes, detected_at, reviewed_at, resolved_at from kg_contradictions where id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}

select id, entity_topic, relationship_a_id, relationship_b_id, source_a_book, source_b_book, description, status, agent_review_result, admin_notes, detected_at, reviewed_at, resolved_at from kg_contradictions order by detected_at desc

select id, entity_topic, relationship_a_id, relationship_b_id, source_a_book, source_b_book, description, status, agent_review_result, admin_notes, detected_at, reviewed_at, resolved_at from kg_contradictions where status = #{status} order by detected_at desc

select id, entity_topic, relationship_a_id, relationship_b_id, source_a_book, source_b_book, description, status, agent_review_result, admin_notes, detected_at, reviewed_at, resolved_at from kg_contradictions where status = #{status} order by detected_at limit #{batchSize}
